spec.description: Operational overview of alert-event-receiver v0.2.0. Metrics represent best-effort lifecycle processing and OTLP exporter calls; no confirmed backend persistence. SDK queue-drop warnings require log monitoring.

spec.title: Scrape targets UP
spec.description: Number of currently scraped receiver targets. Compare against expected target count. Missing series can indicate absent discovery.

spec.title: Webhook p95 processing latency
spec.description: 95th percentile HTTP processing time, aggregated over selected targets.

spec.title: Validated alerts · alerts/s
spec.description: Every valid alert admitted to processing, including repeats and stale alerts.

spec.title: Valkey errors by operation · errors/s
spec.description: Valkey store operation errors, including idempotency SET NX.

spec.title: OTLP export calls by result · calls/s
spec.description: Exporter call result. Successful calls do not prove final VictoriaLogs persistence.

spec.title: Records in OTLP export calls · records/s
spec.description: Records passed to exporter calls grouped by the result of the whole call. Error records are NOT a loss count.

spec.title: OTLP export p95 duration
spec.description: Includes retries within the exporter call; long duration can indicate backend or network problems.

spec.title: OTel SDK diagnostics · errors/s
spec.description: Global SDK error-handler diagnostics. May duplicate exporter failures. Does not count queue-drop log warnings.

spec.title: Synchronous emitter errors · errors/s
spec.description: Errors returned directly by the emitter. The production Logger.Emit API normally cannot report asynchronous export failures.

spec.title: Webhook 5xx · 15m
spec.description: Operational webhook failures in the last 15 minutes. A 500 may cause Alertmanager to retry an entire batch.

spec.title: Processing outcomes · alerts/s
spec.description: Includes normal opened/closed/repeated outcomes and unusual indeterminate, stale, superseded and orphan outcomes.

spec.title: Unusual outcomes · 15m
spec.description: These outcomes merit investigation but are not necessarily service failures. Orphans can arise legitimately after state expiration or restart.

spec.title: Lifecycle events generated vs SDK submitted · events/s
spec.description: Generated before idempotency suppression. Compare with SDK submission, but differences are NOT confirmed loss.

spec.title: Idempotency outcomes · ops/s
spec.description: set=created, exists=suppressed, error=check failed (emission continues).

spec.title: State write results · writes/s
spec.description: Write-path state transition results, including repeated firing updates.

spec.title: Idempotency suppressions and orphan resolutions · /s
spec.description: Suppression and orphan counts provide context; they are not necessarily failures.

spec.title: Valkey operation p95 latency
spec.description: Latency of Valkey operations, grouped by operation.

spec.title: Valkey operation results · ops/s
spec.description: All recorded Valkey operations grouped by result.

spec.title: State entries (local estimate)
spec.description: Not authoritative: locally maintained write-path estimate, may diverge after restart, expiration or multi-instance updates.

spec.title: Webhook 4xx · 15m
spec.description: Invalid requests in the last 15 minutes; generally not resolved by retries.

spec.title: Closed tombstone TTL · p95
spec.description: Observed TTLs applied to closed state tombstones.

spec.title: Valkey errors · 15m
spec.description: Valkey operation failures across all operations; idempotency errors are included here.

spec.title: OTLP failed calls · 15m
spec.description: Failed exporter calls, not necessarily lost records. Includes calls after exporter-managed retries.

spec.title: SDK errors · 15m
spec.description: Global OTel SDK error-handler callbacks; may overlap exporter errors. Queue drops may only appear in structured logs.

spec.title: Target availability
spec.description: 1 = Prometheus scrape succeeds, 0 = scrape fails. If a target disappears from service discovery, this series also disappears.

spec.title: Webhook requests by HTTP class · req/s
spec.description: 2xx successful, 4xx invalid, 5xx processing errors.

spec.title: Alert Event Receiver | Service Health & Delivery (v0.2.0)
